# Coordinate Matrix

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CoordinateMatrix`](gmeow-CoordinateMatrix.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CoordinateMatrix>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`](../../slices/sensory-environment.md)

A multi-dimensional numeric value expressed as a coordinate matrix or vector — the generalisation of [`ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) to vector, matrix, and tensor results. Carries a serialised matrix literal ([`matrixValue`](../properties/gmeow-matrixValue.md)), shape descriptor ([`matrixShape`](../properties/gmeow-matrixShape.md)), reference frame ([`hasReferenceFrame`](../properties/gmeow-hasReferenceFrame.md)), unit ([`hasUnit`](../properties/gmeow-hasUnit.md)), and determinacy ([`hasDeterminacy`](../properties/gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md)). Used for colourspace tuples [j,k,l]+intensity, audio spectra, thermal images, and air-quality compound readings. The actual matrix algebra (dot products, transforms, decompositions) lives in the solver layer ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
